description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single hybrid attacks (1.50 or 1.60 each), grants [Awoken Altruist], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode II (Water, Holy)] and [Blessed Shower Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Altruist
description.text: Holy and Water abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy and Water abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Water, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking] after using a Water/Holy ability

description.name: Blessed Shower Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Water/Holy Blessed Shower after using two Water or Holy abilities if the triggering ability deals Water/Holy damage
